integrity: All eight-edge forest masks and all six dihedral pair orbits are checked using exact integer polynomial arithmetic; subdivision theorem is analytic. No independent audit is represented.

title: Strict weighted arboreal-gas edge anticorrelation on \(K_1*C_4\) and every subdivision
